label: Gjetost
note: Ekte geitost is whey and goat milk only

about.text: A brown Norwegian whey cheese boiled down with goat milk; ekte geitost is made of whey and goat milk only.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Made like brunost, but from goat's whey and goat's milk only, so no cow milk goes in. Neither source gives boiling times, ratios or fat and sugar figures.

facts.v: Caramelised milk sugar: from dark brown to nearly white, brown being the most common in Norway
